stance_rationale: Design direction is documented, but the package cannot pass alpha review because alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, challenge_note, and executable lineage artifacts are absent. The strongest claims are still pre-Forge assertions, while RF-A1~A7, IC diagnostics, PIT C14/C15, AX-007, and AX-008 remain unverified.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Required qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_002/alpha_scores.parquet and qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260517_002/weights.csv are absent; no Date x Ticker x score schedule can be verified.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN strings found; package declares Z_Score_Aligned and learned score sign.
IC/alpha artifacts are pending Forge; Usable_Date <= sig_date cannot be verified from alpha_scores or ic_history.
signal_matrix_ref and Forge data plan point to features_master.parquet; no factor_engine_proposal.R or executable load_month_factors() path was provided.
m4 regime t-1 lag is asserted in design docs, but no generated alpha schedule or overlay artifact exists to verify lag implementation.
Financial-statement lag is asserted in pit_audit_v2.json, but no factor engine code or per-feature Usable_Date audit artifact was present.

critical_concerns.description: RF-A1~A7 are mostly unauditable: sub_stability, composite-vs-best-single ICIR, recent-3Y ICIR, sector-neutral IC retention, top-decile liquidity, Harvey/DSR multi-testing, and time-series alpha schedule are all missing or pending.

The required stage artifact dir A does not exist, and alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are absent; this blocks walk-forward schedule validation, RF-A7 detection, and PSD/condition-number verification.

AX-007 exemption is asserted rather than demonstrated. The claim that sorted-portfolio learning makes EW collapse non-expressible is fragile; score clipping, min-max scaling, softmax tau, and partial adjustment can still produce near-uniform top-20 weights without empirical HHI evidence.

The 80-feature allowlist is dominated by beta, volatility, tail-risk, liquidity, and turnover proxies, which reopens the KR defensive/top20 failure pattern; Gate13 FactorAdjustedAlpha and style R2 are explicitly pending.

Feature lineage is inconsistent: alpha_package and feature_allowlist_v2.sha256 claim f1778f676..., but sha256sum(feature_allowlist_v2.csv) is b3d667517a39..., so artifact integrity is broken before Forge.

Core references are specific papers but not page-specific, and KR transfer is acknowledged without empirical KR evidence; the package leans on non-KR China/US/futures results despite Charter's paper-is-not-approval rule.

Active-weight neutral is treated as trivial, while the non-trivial TE <= 8%, sector active <= 10%, ADV <= 5%, and max-20 constraints have no covariance artifact or feasibility proof; this may silently move failure into projection logic.
No challenge_note or 3-agent context packages were present, so No Silent Override and AX-008 triangulation are not satisfied at this draft stage.

supporting_arguments: The package explicitly inherits v1 failures instead of hiding them: SR -0.34, MDD 65.45%, TO 17.64, Harvey-t -0.42, DSR Z -2.27, and EW collapse.
Purged walk-forward, embargo, 8-model Champion/Challenger comparison, gross/net reporting, and DSR n_trials=100 are specified as Forge obligations.
C13 appears structurally cleaner than prior NEGATE/FLIP_SIGN patterns because the package declares Z_Score_Aligned and no manual sign-flip strings were found.
unresolved_disputes: Whether discovery_design_phase_a is allowed to emit an alpha package with alpha_vector={}, all diagnostics null, and no alpha_scores.parquet.
Whether features_master.parquet reuse complies with PIT-C15 or constitutes prohibited direct parquet loading.
Whether max-20 long-only can satisfy TE <= 8% and sector active <= 10% versus KOSPI200 without excessive benchmark underweight.
Whether the risk/beta/tail-heavy feature set is a disguised defensive top20 sleeve and therefore AX-005/AX-007 exposed.
Whether the stale feature_allowlist_v2.sha256 invalidates the package lineage.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that a non-KR literature-backed architecture redesign is sufficient to overcome v1's empirical KR failure before any alpha_scores, weights, IC, turnover, MDD, Harvey-t, DSR, or HHI artifact exists.
rebuttal_required: Emit alpha_scores.parquet with >=60 monthly sig_dates, Date x Ticker x score schema, and no future dates.
Emit weights.csv and report per-sig_date max_names, bounds, sum_weights, HHI, turnover, ADV usage, TE, and sector active violations.
Emit covariance.parquet and verify PSD plus post-shrink condition number <= 100.
Provide IC diagnostics: rank_IC, ICIR, sub_stability, recent-3Y/full ICIR ratio, sector-neutral IC retention, monotonicity, Harvey t_NW, and DSR.
Resolve feature_allowlist_v2.csv sha256 mismatch and provide artifact_lineage write_json -> record_lineage evidence.
Provide factor_engine_proposal.R or executable Forge code proving PIT C4/C9/C14/C15 compliance.
rationalization_red_flags: EW collapse는 expressible failure mode 아님

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: This is a design memo with strong empirical promises, not a verified alpha package. Forge and Architect evidence are absent, so AX-008 cannot pass.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the factor retain t_NW > 2.95 after FF5/Carhart4/FF6 controls in the same 52-month KR walk-forward period?
Does alpha_scores.parquet prove multi-sig_date PIT generation, especially Usable_Date <= sig_date for fundamental features?
If AX-007 relies on ML sizing, do realized weights show HHI > 0.05 across most sig_dates after clipping, softmax sizing, and partial adjustment?
Does the beta/tail/liquidity-heavy 80-feature set produce residual alpha after size/liquidity/beta regression R2 <= 0.7?
